mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS='PENDING'

SELECT TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS createdAt , SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , CL.CLASS_NAME AS className , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , TRUNC(SYSDATE - C.CREATED_AT) AS elapsedDays , C.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN MEMBER SM ON SD.USER_NO = SM.USER_NO JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON C.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO JOIN CLASS CL ON SM.CLASS_NO = CL.CLASS_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO JOIN MEMBER CM ON CP.USER_NO = CM.USER_NO
WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'APPLIED' AND SM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO
WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'APPLIED' AND SD.STUDENT_STATUS = 'ATTENDING' AND CP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT TO_CHAR(C.CONSULT_DATE,'HH24:MI') AS reservationTime , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName , SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , C.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON C.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN MEMBER SM ON SD.USER_NO = SM.USER_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO JOIN MEMBER CM ON CP.USER_NO = CM.USER_NO
WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND SM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND CM.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND C.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C JOIN STUDENT_DETAIL SD ON C.STUDENT_NO = SD.STUDENT_NO JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE CP ON C.COUNSEL_NO = CP.COUNSEL_NO WHERE C.RESERVATION_STATUS = 'RESERVED' AND SD.STUDENT_STATUS = 'ATTENDING' AND CP.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND C.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1

SELECT C.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName
, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') THEN 1 END) AS currCount
, COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND C.CREATED_AT < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') THEN 1 END) AS prevCount
, ROUND( COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF( SUM( COUNT(CASE WHEN C.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')THEN 1 END) ) OVER(), 0 )* 100 , 1) AS rate
FROM COUNSEL_RESERVATION C LEFT JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON C.CATEGORY_NO = CC.CATEGORY_NO GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NO, CC.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY C.CATEGORY_NO

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, P.* FROM ( SELECT CI.USER_NO AS userNo , CM.USER_NAME AS userName , CL.CLASS_NAME AS className , CL.CLASS_NO AS classNo , CI.INVITE_NO AS inviteNo , COUNT(CASE WHEN CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED' THEN 1 END) OVER() AS counselorCount , C.COUNSEL_NO AS counselNo , CC.CATEGORY_NO AS categoryNo , CC.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName
FROM COUNSELOR_INVITE CI LEFT JOIN MEMBER CM ON CM.USER_NO = CI.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE C ON CM.USER_NO = C.USER_NO LEFT JOIN CLASS CL ON CL.CLASS_NO = CM.CLASS_NO LEFT JOIN COUNSEL_CATEGORY CC ON CC.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO
WHERE CI.INVITE_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'USED')
WHERE CI.INVITE_STATUS = 'USED'
AND CM.STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY CI.USER_NO NULLS FIRST, CM.USER_NAME )P ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
